primaryChecks.text: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they struck Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim, and all the storage cities of Naphtali.
primaryChecks.previousContext: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, as there was between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent you silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”
primaryChecks.nextContext: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and let his work cease.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 本文に地名が明記され、当該文脈でこの町・地形として用いられる。

wikipediaRead.title: Abel-beth-maachah
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 記事はテルを聖書のアベル・ベト・マアカに同定し、アベル・マイムを2歴代誌16:4に現れる同じ都市の別名として記す。遺跡はメトゥラ近郊の北部イスラエルにある。
